from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == 8)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a == b else background for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
